title: Check: Angles of Elevation and Depression

questions.stem: From the top of a $50\text{ m}$ cliff, the angle of depression to a boat is $30°$. How far is the boat from the base of the cliff? Give an exact answer.
questions.explanation: The angle of depression equals the angle of elevation from the boat. $\tan 30° = \frac{50}{d}$, so $d = \frac{50}{\tan 30°} = \frac{50}{\frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}} = 50\sqrt{3}\text{ m}$.
